fixed.item: finish_breakages.json (electrical; plumbing_liquids' request): live mains gear under a dripping pot never took ingress however much water gathered on it. Drips reach phys.wetted in 5 ml portions (the kernel's droplet limit: the kernel's drip law and plumbing's leaks.drip_onto, one call per substep), each under INGRESS_L (0.02 L), and physical._liquid_ingress judged INGRESS_L per call; only power's soaked-device ground fault (wetness above 0.4) ever tripped a GFCI, and the device never took water_ingress.
fixed.how: house_sim/systems/electrical/physical.py: _gathers(w, eid, rec, liters) adds the litres reaching a device to what reached it since it was last dry (electrical section 'gathering' {device: litres}, written only for arrivals under 20 ml while the device has a film; never perceived) and lets liquid in once the sum reaches INGRESS_L (the gathering is spent); a single 20 ml arrival behaves exactly as before, and everything after the threshold (rated gear, GFCI / GFCI-breaker trip or shock risk, battery short, water_ingress until dry, robot attribution through _wet_by_robot) is unchanged. A device dry again (wetness at most GATHER_DRY 0.001: no film left) forgets its litres: the new system electrical.wet_gear (order 77, right after cleaning.drying 75 and appliances_cooking.drying 76; exact idle probe wet_gear_idle, about 0.13 us per substep, idle while nothing gathers) and the dry-device refresher sync_dry_devices (forget_dried); liquid that leaves no film (a seep from a wet thing resting on dry gear, a device without a top) does not gather. gathered_l(state, eid) reads it. Docs: docs/domains/electrical.md sections 4, 11 (Physics) and 15.

not_fixed.item: Own finding (cross-domain): 71 electrical gear types (lamps, bulbs, chargers, power strips, outlets, switches, smoke / CO alarms, remotes, clocks, NiMH cells, tool packs) inherit the core default water_safe: true and are not marked electronic, so every domain that asks 'electronic or water_safe is False' treats them as water-safe: plumbing's leaks.drip_onto takes a plugged wireless_charging_pad under a dripping pot for a waterproof drip catcher (20 ml pool in pooled_l in 2 minutes, phys.wetted never runs, so no ingress / GFCI trip), cleaning's liquid-ingress checks (engine wet wipe, surfaces rinse_item under the tap) and mechanisms' dispense damage read the same flag.
not_fixed.why: Marking the gear water_safe: false in house_sim/data/types/electrical.json changes every generated house's records (tests/data/gen1_digests.json: the close-out packages' rules do not allow 'gen1') and other domains' cleaning, drip and dispense outcomes (spec verdicts to re-attribute across owners). It needs the owners' A/B and a generation-1 re-record, so it belongs to the next phase (request below). Repro: scratchpad repro_plumbing_catcher.py (a pot with drip_lpm 0.02 on a plugged wireless_charging_pad on a bathroom GFCI receptacle, wait 120 s: wetness 0.0, pooled_l 0.02, no water_ingress, GFCI not tripped).

not_fixed.item: Known limit of the dry test: a device dried by a system that runs before order 77 (outdoor_plants' weather, 45-46) and wetted again later in the same substep before order 77 (the kernel's drip law, 48) still counts the litres gathered before it dried.
not_fixed.why: The hook sees the wetness after the arrival only (the kernel writes it before phys.wetted runs), so it cannot tell at the arrival whether the device had dried; the gap needs outdoor non-rated gear under a kernel drip in the very substep the weather dries it. A kernel change (request below) closes it; documented in docs/domains/electrical.md section 15.

requests.request: phys.wetted: pass the wetness the thing had before this arrival (or the litres it kept), e.g. fn(w, eid, liters, liquid, source, wet_before=None) from liquids.wet / environment.rain_wet / thermal's wet-contact seep. Electrical's ingress gathering forgets the litres of a device that dried (house_sim/systems/electrical/physical.py _gathers); today it learns of the drying from its electrical.wet_gear system (order 77) and refresher, and a device dried by a system ordered before 77 (outdoor_plants' weather 45-46) and dripped on by the kernel's drip law (48) in the same substep still counts its old litres. Repro: dry a gear record's wetness to 0 inside a system of order < 48 in the substep a liquids.drip_start portion lands on it.

Next phase, with plumbing_liquids, cleaning and mechanisms: decide water sensitivity of electrical gear. 71 gear types in house_sim/data/types/electrical.json inherit core water_safe: true (registry BASE_PROPS) and none is 'electronic', so plumbing_liquids leaks._water_sensitive / drip_onto, cleaning engine (wet wipe) and surfaces rinse_item, and mechanisms dispense treat a plugged lamp, charger, power strip, outlet or smoke alarm as water-safe (repro: a drip_lpm 0.02 pot on a plugged wireless_charging_pad pools 20 ml in 2 min and phys.wetted never runs). Either electrical marks its gear water_safe: false (a generation-1 re-record and the owners' A/B) or the readers ask one shared predicate (electrical's physical.electrical_gear, or the kernel props' water sensitivity of the electronics class).
